description: Correctness fixes: asset resolution, commit verification, provider adapters, isolated progress commits, exit codes, README accuracy, AGENTS.md preservation

userStories.title: Fix asset resolution for npm-installed CLI
userStories.description: As a user installing nightralph via npm, I want the setup command to find its bundled skills and templates so that setup works without running from a source checkout.
acceptanceCriteria: scriptDir in src/index.ts is derived from import.meta.url via fileURLToPath instead of process.argv[1]
setup locates skills/ and docs-templates/ relative to the compiled module, not the bin symlink
Existing tests still pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Line 24 of src/index.ts: `const scriptDir = dirname(process.argv[1])`. Replace with `dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))` using fileURLToPath from node:url.

userStories.title: Verify agent commits before marking done
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the orchestrator to verify that an agent actually committed changes before merging and marking a ticket done, so that work is never silently lost.
acceptanceCriteria: After an agent exits 0, the orchestrator checks whether the worktree branch has new commits relative to the base branch using git rev-list --count
If no new commits exist, the ticket is NOT marked done and the worktree is NOT cleaned up
If the worktree has uncommitted changes (dirty via git status --porcelain), the ticket is NOT marked done and the uncommitted state is reported to the console
The in-place execution path (runWaves) checks for commits on the current branch before calling markDone
Tests cover the no-commit and dirty-worktree scenarios
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Add helper functions hasNewCommits(repoRoot, base, branch) and isDirty(cwd) in src/worktree.ts. Use them in both runWavesIsolated and runWaves before markDone.

userStories.title: Add non-interactive provider adapters
userStories.description: As a user running nightralph claude or nightralph codex, I want the CLI to invoke the correct non-interactive command so that agents run without hanging on interactive prompts.
acceptanceCriteria: claude provider spawns with --print flag prepended to args
codex provider spawns with exec subcommand prepended to args
Unknown providers are passed through as-is (current behavior)
--model flag is still forwarded correctly for all providers
Tests cover command construction for claude, codex, and an unknown provider
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: In spawnAgent (src/orchestrator.ts line 223), add a provider-aware adapter before building the args array. A simple switch or map keyed on the command basename is enough.

userStories.title: Isolate progress commits
userStories.description: As a user with staged changes in my repo, I want progress commits to contain only the progress file so that my staged work is not swept into an automated commit.
acceptanceCriteria: commitProgress in src/progress.ts uses git commit -- <progressPath> so only the named path is committed from the index
Existing staged files in the repo are untouched by the progress commit
Tests verify that a pre-staged file is not included in the progress commit
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Line 114 of src/progress.ts: change ['commit', '-m', message] to ['commit', '-m', message, '--', progressPath] so only the progress file is committed.

userStories.title: Return nonzero exit code for incomplete runs
userStories.description: As a CI pipeline or monitoring script, I want nightralph to exit with a nonzero status when any ticket fails or remains incomplete so that I can detect failed runs.
acceptanceCriteria: runWaves and runWavesIsolated return a result object indicating whether all ready tickets completed successfully
The CLI calls process.exit(1) when any ready ticket failed, was not merged, or remains ready-for-agent
Successful runs (all tickets done) exit 0
Dry runs always exit 0
Tests verify exit behavior for both success and failure cases
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: runWaves currently returns void. Change to return { allDone:boolean }. In the CLI handler in src/index.ts, check the result and call process.exit(1) when !allDone.

userStories.title: Patch README inaccuracies
userStories.description: As a user reading the README, I want the documentation to match current behavior so that I can follow it without hitting surprises.
acceptanceCriteria: The opening paragraph describes local markdown tickets only and notes that choosing GitHub during setup installs GitHub-oriented skill instructions (not a remote issue source)
Path references use .agents/skills/ instead of ./claude/skills/ or ./agents.skills/
The flags table includes the -X flag
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Documentation-only change. Read current README.md and fix the three specific inaccuracies identified in the audit.

userStories.title: Preserve existing AGENTS.md during setup
userStories.description: As a user running setup in a project that already has an AGENTS.md, I want my existing instructions preserved so that setup does not silently destroy project-specific content.
acceptanceCriteria: Setup writes its content inside managed-section markers (<!-- nightralph:start --> / <!-- nightralph:end -->)
If AGENTS.md exists and contains managed markers, only the managed section is replaced
If AGENTS.md exists without markers, the managed section is appended and existing content is preserved
If no AGENTS.md exists, the file is created with the managed section (current content wrapped in markers)
Tests cover all three cases: no file, file without markers, file with markers
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Modify the AGENTS.md writing logic in src/setup.ts. Add a helper like writeManagedSection(filePath, content, startMarker, endMarker).
